children: Canada real estate developer's Q3 revenue fell 16.7% yr/yr
Q3 FFO declined 27% due to lower land sales and property dispositions
Q3 net income rose 26%, reflecting lower fair-value losses and non-cash financing recoveries
Company says economic uncertainty and elevated costs continue to impact market conditions
Company sees Alberta real estate demand supported by population growth and demographic trends
Company says timing of lot sales remains unpredictable, impacting quarterly results
LAND SALES DECLINE - Co said lower U.S. land sales and reduced gross profit in Land division weighed on results
PROPERTY DISPOSITIONS - Recent property sales reduced Properties revenue and FFO, partly offset by newly developed commercial properties
GOLF WEATHER IMPACT - Co said unfavorable weather led to fewer rounds played, offset by higher clubhouse revenue
